entities.summary: Mario Giordano is a German writer. His novel Black Box (1999), which is based on a true occurrence was adapted to a film under the name Das Experiment directed by Oliver Hirschbiegel. The film was acclaimed and Giordano received for it among other prizes the Bavarian Film Award for Best Screenplay.
